text.description_html:
First Impressions SDS3/8x1" Cylinder Style Shower Door Stop

This cylinder style upright shower door stop is very easy to install. Packaged with a mounting anchor and rubber bumper ring.

Sleek, clean looking, and great protection for your shower door hardware and walls.

Only 1 hole to drill for fast easy installation. The rubber bumper ring goes all the way around the door stop, allowing you to install it just about anywhere on the floor for door contact.

Specifications of First Impressions SDS3/8x1 Shower Door Stop

  • Diameter: 3/8"
  • Base to Bumper Center Height: 1"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Rubber Bumper: Black
  • Includes Mounting Hardware
  • Available in Satin Nickel or Polished Chrome finish

*Sold Individually.
